_why: The three delivered programs the reviewing coach scored in Phase 1, mapped to the committed fixtures that hold them. Derived once by matching audit signatures and opening lines after the scratchpad copies were lost in a container rebuild; recorded here so it never has to be derived again. Dimension scores are the coach's, and reproduce his overall score through engine/coach_standard.js.
